item.title: Indiana ‘deadline’ approaches for possible Chicago Bears stadium deal
item.description: Indiana leaders are pushing for a financial agreement for a potential Chicago Bears stadium in northwest Indiana to be finalized before the end of the legislative session on Feb. 27, 2026.

item.title: Comedian Mike Epps gives teens a path forward through new boxing gym
item.description: Comedian Mike Epps opened a boxing gym in Indianapolis to give teens a safe haven to build confidence and learn conflict resolution.

item.title: Gillespie’s 22 points lead Kent State to victory over Ball State
item.description: Kent State beat Ball State 75-68 on Saturday, led by Delrecco Gillespie's 22 points and 14 rebounds.

item.title: ‘Great Day TV:’ Remembering the Eskenazi couple’s legacy of generosity and compassion
item.description: Lois and Sidney Eskenazi were honored for their $40 million gift to Eskenazi Health, which was the largest ever given to a public health facility at the time, and for their commitment to public health care and individual dignity.

item.title: Harris and Cox lead No. 13 Purdue to 78 – 57 win over Iowa
item.description: No. 13 Purdue beat Iowa 78-57 on Saturday, extending their winning streak to four with an efficient offense that consistently found openings.

item.title: IMPD chief condemns officer’s language in viral traffic stop video
item.description: The Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department's new chief defended a Feb. 6 traffic stop in which an officer threatened to kill a teenage driver, while condemning the language used by the officer. Findings from an internal review of the traffic stop have been given to the Marion County Prosecutor’s Office for consideration.

item.title: Elkhart police target of violent threats, City says
item.description: The Elkhart Police Department has received multiple threats following a police shooting that resulted in the death of a 17-year-old male. The officers involved have been placed on administrative leave while the homicide unit investigates.

item.title: Warming rain tonight then a breezy spring tease midweek| Feb. 14, 2026
item.description: A soggy night in Indy gives way to a gradual warmup over the next week, with temperatures reaching the 60s by midweek and a chance of rain returning late week.

item.description: SPEEDWAY, Ind. (WISH) — A next era for the Indy Eleven officially began Saturday. item.title: Plans for ICE office in Carmel spark fear and uncertainty
item.description: The Carmel City Council president has confirmed that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will establish an office in Carmel. The plan has caused fear and concern among community members, some of whom have coworkers, friends and family members affected by ICE's actions.
